create_point_geometry: create a Point object with x and y coordinates for numerical geometry calculations
create_line_from_points: create a Line object from two Point objects or from line coefficients
create_circle_from_points: create a Circle object from a center and radius or three points on the circle
check_collinearity: check if a list of Point objects are collinear using check_coll function
compute_line_intersection: compute the intersection point of two Line objects using line_line_intersection
